mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below its 12-month moving average signals monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend over 20-day returns remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day return in declining FEDFUNDS periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE rising above 5.0% within 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in HOUST signals accommodative policy and strong housing demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST-FEDFUNDS interaction over 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year window, or average return in interaction periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, HOUST declining relative to GDPC1 signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST/GDPC1 ratio trend over 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year window, or average return in declining ratio periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST rising above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST trend over 5-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year window, or average 5-day return in rising HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 200 signals elevated inflation, prompting Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200, or average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (3mo) and UNRATE < 4.5% signal labor market tightening, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS-UNRATE joint condition over 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year window, or average return in joint condition periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint INDPRO and GDPC1 rising above their 6-month moving averages signals robust economic output, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO/GDPC1 joint trend over 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year window, or average return in joint rise periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
